prompt:
Goal: Create a dramatic vertical Japanese promotional poster for a summer motorcycle touring challenge, blending anime key visual art with event announcement typography.

Canvas: Tall smartphone poster, 9:16 aspect ratio, dark cinematic blue color grading, high contrast, glowing cyan-white typography, rain and water-splash effects.

Layout: At the very top, place a small KusArt logo on the left with thin decorative horizontal lines and diamond endpoints. Center the small header text 「お盆休み企画」, then below it 「OPTION追加」. The dominant title fills the upper third in huge luminous Japanese calligraphy: 夏の一瞬チャレンジ. Under the title, add a thin divider line and a two-line subtitle: 「その瞬間にしか出会えない夏を、」 and 「ツーリング作品の見せ場に。」

Main visual: A beautiful anime-style female motorcycle rider with long flowing crimson red hair and vivid blue eyes rides a glossy black sport touring motorcycle with subtle red and gold trim. She wears a tight black leather racing suit with red accent panels, black gloves, and a confident gentle expression. The motorcycle is angled toward the viewer on a wet mountain road curve, front wheel large in the lower foreground, windshield sparkling with raindrops, tires kicking up water spray.

Environment: Split the sky into a “summer moment” contrast: the left side is bright blue sky with towering white cumulonimbus clouds, distant mountains, and a lake or coastline below; the right side is a sudden dark evening rain shower with dense vertical rain streaks. The road is glossy and reflective, bordered by guardrails and lush green mountain foliage, with sunlight breaking through the rain to create a magical fleeting-summer atmosphere.

Bottom information area: Add exactly 3 glowing cyan outlined text blocks near the bottom. Block 1 is a small pill-shaped label reading 「イラスト・動画どちらもOK」. Block 2 is a large hashtag bar reading #AIあつあつツーリング動画. Block 3 is a second large hashtag bar reading #AIあつあつツーリングイラスト. At the very bottom, display the deadline in large bright numerals and Japanese text: 8/16 23:59まで, with thin decorative lines and diamond endpoints.

Visual style: Premium anime illustration, highly detailed motorcycle rendering, glossy wet surfaces, cinematic lighting, electric blue glow, crisp Japanese typography, rain particles, water droplets, dramatic poster composition, polished social media campaign design.

Constraints: Keep all text legible and in the specified Japanese wording. Use exactly one rider, one motorcycle, three bottom text blocks, and one deadline line. Do not add extra logos, extra hashtags, QR codes, or watermarks beyond the small KusArt logo.

promptZh:
目标：创作一张极具戏剧性的竖版日本夏季摩托车骑行挑战赛宣传海报，融合动漫主视觉艺术与活动公告排版。

画布：竖版智能手机海报，9:16 比例，深色电影级蓝色调，高对比度，青白色发光字体，雨水与水花飞溅效果。

布局：顶部左侧放置一个小型 KusArt 标志，配以纤细的装饰性水平线和菱形端点。居中放置小标题文字「お盆休み企画」，下方为「OPTION追加」。主标题占据上方三分之一区域，使用巨大的发光日式书法字体：夏の一瞬チャレンジ。标题下方添加一条细分割线及两行副标题：「その瞬間にしか出会えない夏を、」和「ツーリング作品の見せ場に。」

主视觉：一位美丽的动漫风格女性摩托车骑手，拥有 飘逸的长红发 和生动的蓝色双眸，骑着一辆带有红金细节点缀的亮黑色运动旅行摩托车。她身穿紧身黑色皮质赛车服，配有红色装饰面板，戴着黑色手套，表情自信而温柔。摩托车在湿滑的山路弯道上朝向观众，前轮位于前景下方，挡风玻璃上闪烁着雨滴，轮胎激起阵阵水雾。

环境：将天空分割为“夏日瞬间”的对比效果：左侧是明亮的蓝天，点缀着高耸的白色积雨云、远山及下方的湖泊或海岸线；右侧是突如其来的傍晚阵雨，伴随着密集的垂直雨幕。路面光亮且具有反射感，边缘设有护栏和郁郁葱葱的山间植被，阳光穿透雨幕，营造出一种梦幻般的夏日瞬间氛围。

底部信息区：在底部附近添加 3 个青色发光轮廓的文本块。第 1 个是小型胶囊状标签，文字为「イラスト・動画どちらもOK」。第 2 个是大型标签栏，文字为 #AIあつあつツーリング動画。第 3 个是第二个大型标签栏，文字为 #AIあつあつツーリングイラスト。最底部显示醒目的数字和日文截止日期：8/16 23:59まで，并配以装饰性细线和菱形端点。

视觉风格：高级动漫插画，高细节摩托车渲染，湿润光泽表面，电影级灯光，电光蓝辉光，清晰的日文排版，雨滴粒子，水珠，戏剧性海报构图，精致的社交媒体活动设计。

限制：确保所有文字清晰易读，并使用指定的日文措辞。仅限一名骑手、一辆摩托车、三个底部文本块和一行截止日期。除 KusArt 标志外，不得添加额外的标志、标签、二维码或水印。
